        beams.append(b)
    return cabin

    vel = sandbox.get_vehicle_velocity()
    current_speed = math.hypot(vel[0], vel[1])
    
    # Apply force in mud zone to counteract resistance

        # Apply forward force to maintain speed through resistance
        sandbox.apply_force(agent_body, (1500, 0))

            sandbox.apply_force(agent_body, (1200, 0))

            # Apply backward force to slow down

    elif 10.5 <= current_x <= 11.0:
        if current_speed < 2.8:
            # Apply forward impulse to meet speed trap requirement
            sandbox.apply_force(agent_body, (1200, 0))
